text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Friday that it reaffirmed the ratings of Canadian Utilities Ltd.
The company's commercial paper rating remained at A-1+, its debentures and medium-term note debentures at A+ and the preferred shares at P-1.
The rating outlook for the company remained stable, CBRS said.

Canadian Utilities' very good quality ratings reflected its diversified operations, strong service area, steady growth in customer base and growing energy use in Alberta, relatively low cost structure and sound financial position, the agency said.

Over the past few years, the company had generated improvements in its earnings and cash flow, while its capitalization measures and coverage ratios remained at satisfactory levels for its current rating category CBRS said.
